source.unit: Meteorology I.10, entire chapter between Part10 andPart11.
source.content: Dew and frost differ by the path of cooled vapour. Low elevation, clear/calm conditions and a Pontus reversal of usual wind associations enter the explanation; a well-vapour comparison is retained.

design.whole_passage_relation: The full reading must cover day/night formation, the alternative paths, elevation restriction, ordinary regional condition, Pontus exception, well analogy and closing claim. No clause dropped to make one deterministic rule.
two_reused_input_cases: Vapour condenses before freezing versus vapour freezing first: outcome names differ.
The same named wind is associated differently in Pontus and elsewhere: region must be a real argument.
design.rival: One universal temperature/direction rule, or a regional list with no causal phase dependency.
design.distinct_consequence: An explicit geographic guard changes the rule while phase-event order remains distinct; a universal wind rule cannot express the reversal unchanged.
design.falsifier: Fail if the whole reading makes the exception universal or silently uses wind to mean current movement in one statement and prevailing regime in another. The calm/wind tension may leave the model incomplete.
design.smallest_step: Freeze both a literal simultaneous-wind interpretation and an explicitly added prior-weather interpretation before target fitting; keep any source contradiction instead of repairing it.
new_costs: Separating prior weather from present wind would be a new interpretation, not textually certified.
No actual weather prediction or physical endorsement.
predecessors: IDEA000306 already proposed paired atmospheric labels with an unmatched phenomenon; this new unit is a full causal branch with a regional exception, not another inventory test.
design.main_gap: The source itself needs careful scope interpretation; the primary Greek and target grammar are uncollated.

duplicate_screen.limit: Common-design vocabulary dominated ranking. Targeted source searches and predecessor primary reads above provide navigation; no novelty certification.
